high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: adrenergic agonist infusion. Dose errors produce severe hypertension or end-organ hypoperfusion.
adult_dose: Start 0.01–0.05 mcg/kg/min; titrate q5min to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg. Typical range 0.05–0.5 mcg/kg/min; doses >1 mcg/kg/min suggest refractory shock.
pediatric_dose: 0.05–0.1 mcg/kg/min, titrate to MAP goal per weight-based PICU protocol.
max_dose: No absolute ceiling; high doses (>1 mcg/kg/min) warrant second vasopressor.
indications: Septic shock after adequate fluid resuscitation
contraindications: Extravasation risk — infuse through central line when possible; peripheral >4h requires large-bore IV + monitoring
key_monitoring: Peripheral perfusion, capillary refill, skin mottling

provenance.note: Scaffold entry for five-rights-verification workflow. Verify against facility infusion protocol before administration.
